summary: Frontend refactor verification complete. Stage 1 component extraction (TourPlayer → 6 modular files) tested successfully. All player functionality works identically to before the refactor.

welcome_screen.details: Welcome screen renders with data-testid='player-welcome', logo, title ('Mystery Served'), body text, and custom button label ('START — LETS GO')

start_tour_transition.details: Clicking Start Tour transitions to first stop with correct header showing tour title, progress bar, and stop/page counter

normal_page_view.details: Normal page shows stop title, page content, themed divider with rotating icons, and Previous/Next navigation buttons

previous_button_disabled.details: Previous button correctly disabled on first page (isFirstPage check working)

next_button_navigation.details: Next button advances through pages, progress counter updates correctly

page_navigation_within_stop.details: Navigating through multiple pages within a stop works (Page 1 → Page 2 → Page 3)

stop_navigation.details: Navigating between stops works (Stop 1 Page 3 → Stop 2 Page 1 with 12% progress)

unlock_gate_text_mode.details: Unlock gate displays correctly with data-testid='player-unlock-gate', text input field (data-testid='unlock-input'), and Continue button (data-testid='unlock-submit')

correct_answer_flow.details: Entering correct answer 'C' shows success message and auto-advances to next page

wrong_answer_error.details: Entering wrong answer shows red error message 'Not quite. Take another look — you're closer than you think.'

admin_login.details: Admin dashboard login works with demo/demo123 credentials, redirects to tours list

tours_list.details: Tours list displays 17 tour cards with New Tour button and Logout button

tour_editor.details: Tour editor loads correctly with title input, Save Draft, Publish buttons, Welcome Screen sidebar item, Add Stop button, and Share Assets panel

refactor_verification.app_js_changes: Import PlayerLayout, removed TourPlayer definition (~1255 lines), updated route to use PlayerLayout
refactor_verification.behavior_changes: NONE - 1:1 extraction refactor with zero feature/design/behavior changes

critical_code_review_comments: React hooks dependency warnings in PlayerLayout.jsx (useEffect missing dependencies) - these are intentional to prevent infinite loops but could be refactored with useCallback
react-beautiful-dnd console warnings about isDropDisabled in tour editor - development-only warning, not affecting functionality
